summary: A plain, hand-coded single page for a free, pay-what-you-want Futura-inspired sans. It leads with weight and italic sliders on the editable name, then reads like a narrow justified document with red accents. Its idea is that almost every text on the page is contenteditable, so the page is the tester.

instances.look: 'Jost*' at 187px, charcoal with a red asterisk, on pale grey, above two long thin sliders labelled 'weight: book' and 'italic: 0%'. A small 'indestructible type*' link sits above it and was not cut as a block
instances.ux: Drag the sliders to change the name's weight and slant; the labels update with style names and a percentage; the name itself can be retyped
instances.learn: Make the wordmark the tester: two sliders directly under a name, labelled in words instead of numbers, explain the variable axes in one gesture

reconstruction.layout: Centred; foundry link y≈10; name y≈105–375; sliders 1220px wide, x≈110, at y≈535 and y≈620 with labels centred above them; ~970px down to the next block
reconstruction.typography: Name 187px Jostvf at wght 400; red asterisk; labels 40px wght 400 in grey; foundry link ~20px
